description: This file defines a React functional component called LoginPage which renders a login form with email and password fields. It uses React hooks such as useState and useContext to manage state and access authentication context. The form submits login credentials to a login function and navigates to the home page upon successful login.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission by preventing default behavior, calling the login function with email and password, and navigating to the root route upon success.
